definitions.explanation: To give precedence or make way for someone.
To pass ownership or responsibility to another.

notes:
{譲|ゆず}る means to yield, give way, or hand over something to another person.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: AがBに〜を{譲|ゆず}る (A yields/gives ~ to B)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道|みち}を{譲|ゆず}る: to give way, yield the road
- {席|せき}を{譲|ゆず}る: to give up one's seat
- {後|あと}を{譲|ゆず}る: to hand over (succession)
- {権利|けんり}を{譲|ゆず}る: to transfer rights
- {一歩|いっぽ}も{譲|ゆず}らない: not give an inch

RELATED WORDS:
- {譲|ゆず}り{合|あ}う: to yield to each other, compromise
- {譲渡|じょうと}: transfer (formal/legal term)

USAGE:
Commonly used on public transport signs encouraging passengers to yield seats to elderly or disabled people: {席|せき}をお{譲|ゆず}りください.
